svg.title: Electricity demand against temperature with a straight-line fit, and the residuals of that fit
svg.desc: Fitted model: demand = 105.7 − 0.79 × temperature, R² 0.50. Residuals curve: they average +10 GWh below 2 °C, −6 GWh between 12 and 20 °C and +14 GWh at 26 °C and above, so the line underestimates demand at both extremes.
svg.text: What it misses: residual = observed − fitted
Residual, GWh. Band: ±2 SD of residuals (±13.8)
